source_revision: c26378c (profile commit); the EFI sources are unchanged in later commits on this branch, which touch only tests, docs, header comments and the USB manifest name list

hardware.bios: F13 (AMI, 2021-07-08), CSM disabled, Above 4G Decoding and Re-Size BAR disabled, Secure Boot enabled but not active (setup mode)
hardware.gpu: NVIDIA reference-subsystem RTX 3060 12 GiB (GA104) 10de:2487 / 10de:2487, bus 06:00.0 behind root port 00:03.1
hardware.display: one monitor on the RTX over HDMI (single-RTX headless topology, non-aggregate console, one nvgop display child, ADR 0x80010370)

software.toolchain: LLVM 20.1.8, MSVC Build Tools 14.44, firmware assets generated on Windows with Python 3.14.4 (built-in zstd) from the pinned upstream scripts; all five hashes match unlock/assets.json
software.benchmark: torch 2.11.0+cu128 cuBLAS, n=4096, FP32 accumulation (reduced-precision reduction off), 2 s warm-up, median of 30 samples of ten multiplies, all-ones reference check

route: headless USB (GU_USB_MEDIA), FAT32 MBR stick, firmware boot menu (F12)

efi.note: Built with research/headless/build-usb.ps1 -HardwareProfile b550-3060. The wrapper embeds the builder's Windows ESP GUID, so other machines get a different wrapper hash.

probe.note: three cold boots of the read-only USB observation EFI (probe-b550-3060, PROM dump on each); identical identity, BAR0, PROM digest, GOP path and driver fingerprints; only the entry selector SS0 differs

firmware_fingerprints.nvgop: version 0x6000a, image 0x2be40, stop 0x698, .text 0x24426 bytes sha256 8924ba48...b276 (new; not seen on any other profile)
firmware_fingerprints.console_text: image 0x5b80, stop 0xe6c (one of three bindings of the same image; the one holding the RTX GOP child)

runs.boot: full shutdown, F12 to the USB stick
runs.release: console text and graphics, EDID and nvgop 0x6000a detached and verified
runs.final: status=0 clean=1 FLR=1, fault=0 retained=0 maps=0

tflops_medians.note: No locked baseline on this machine with this script. For reference, the B660-PLUS GA104 RTX 3060 profile recorded locked FP32/TF32/FP16/BF16 of 7.99/12.98/26.12/25.77 with the same method.

application.note: contributor's wall-clock observation; the card runs a few degrees warmer when unlocked
